name: io.github.Vuena/vuena-assets
title: Vuena Assets
description: Search and download 76 free CC0 low-poly 3D models (GLB) into your game project.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search 76 free CC0 low-poly 3D models (characters, animals, vehicles, props, food, winter, horror, store/gas-station/factory/apartment items). Returns the best matches with GLB and preview URLs. Query examples: "tree", "rigged fox walk", "traffic cone", "christmas". Use tags to narrow (e.g. ["winter"], ["psx"]), rigged=true for animated characters/animals.

query.description: What you need, in plain words, e.g. "pine tree" or "knight". May be empty if you pass tags.

tags.description: Only models having ALL these tags/categories, e.g. ["winter"], ["characters"], ["psx"].

rigged.description: true = only rigged (skinned, animated) models; false = only static models.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Full details for one model id (from search_assets): triangle count, size in metres, animation clip names, URLs for GLB and preview image, licence, and the matching paid pack (if any).

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Lists the free download and the optional paid full packs on itch.io that the free models are samples of, with short descriptions and URLs. Honest note: the free models here are enough on their own; the packs are for people who want a full library in the same style.
